task_description: Enhance the Naukri auto-apply bot with LLM-powered intelligence using Groq API. Two major enhancements: (1) LLM-powered form filling that replaces rule-based heuristics with intelligent form analysis, screening question answering, and adaptive navigation. (2) Quota bypass via direct company applications - when Naukri's 50-application limit is hit, the bot uses the LLM to find and apply directly on company career pages.
